name: Walks out of frame
text: She walks out of frame to the left.
desc: Departure, and the one subject card that survives any staging - the subject is gone from frame by f72-f96 whether they start as a distant figure or fill the lens, because leaving the frame is a path that exists at every shot size. Reach for it when the staging is not known in advance.
